title: russias gazprom posts 12 fall first half profit 2026 08 28
text:
MOSCOW, Aug 28 (Reuters) - Russian gas producer Gazprom's (GAZP.MM)
, opens new tab
 first-half profit reached 864 billion roubles ($10 billion) around 12% lower than a year ​ago, the company said on Friday, citing ​the impact of a stronger rouble.
Its second-quarter ⁠profit by contrast increased to 518.6 billion roubles, ​up more than 60% from the same period ​in 2024, supported by higher oil and gas prices.
The results are for the Gazprom Group whose assets include oil ​and gas production, as well as power generation.
Gazprom ​has said it expects an increase in domestic supplies and ‌exports ⁠to China to lead to growth of 6% to 7% in core earnings this year.
Because many of its sales are paid for in international currencies, ​a stronger ​rouble means ⁠its financial results reported in roubles are comparatively weaker.
Once the largest natural gas ​supplier to the European market, Gazprom ​has ⁠lost most of its European customers since Russia's war on Ukraine, which began in 2022, and deepened economic ⁠and ​political rifts with the West.
($1 = ​86.1455 roubles)
